groups.defect: `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` has no optional chaining, so Google Meet bookings throw a TypeError when destinationCalendar is null or empty.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same missing optional chaining at EventManager.ts lines 117-119, and they all propose the same one-line fix.

groups.defect: The Google updateEvent and deleteEvent fallbacks search for `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` only when externalCalendarId is falsy, so they never match and the calendarId is undefined or wrong.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same dead lookup at lines 254-256 and also points to the same copy in deleteEvent at lines 315-317.

groups.defect: destinationCalendar is set to null instead of [], so `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` does nothing and collective team members' calendars are dropped.
groups.rationale: These are identical reports about the same lines in handleNewBooking, and they share the same fix.

groups.defect: The organization slug condition is inverted: the slug is now set when team billing is enabled instead of when it is disabled.
groups.rationale: Both report that the same negation was dropped on line 151 of create.handler.ts.

groups.defect: Office365 createEvent (and likewise Lark and the CalDAV BaseCalendarService) always uses the first destination calendar and ignores credentialId, so collective team members' events are sent to the organizer's calendar.
groups.rationale: Both report the same defect in Office365 createEvent and both mention Lark. One member also names the CalDAV service, so the merged comment needs to cover all three services.
